|errata_history={{Card errata/Elis In Hinthra}}
This is the errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-D-elisinhinthra.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-D-elisinhinthra-2022-07-31-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-D-elisinhinthra-2022-07-05.png]], 5 July 2022) → [[File:V0-D-elisinhinthra-2022-07-31-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-D-elisinhinthra.gif]], 31 July 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E1”, the same mark as the previous version: the words did not change.
* '''Original''' ([[Elis In Hinthra]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-elisinhinthra022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/elisinhinthra.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/elisinhinthra.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•''Virago''”. Text: “May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Elis, who provides ability of 2. Once per game, may ▼ a smuggler aboard. While at opponent's system, adds one [Light Side]. Immune to attrition <5.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Elis In Hinthra (Errata)]]): '''First published 22 June 2021''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/hires/elis_in_hinthra.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ee4c4cd8bccdd1870eb7593e38093132a51fe2c4 commit ee4c4cd]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 22 June 2021<ref name="img-elisinhinthra30816d1">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/elisinhinthra.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/30816d1eceffdd0a07a5af277fcbcbc9fc96f665 commit 30816d1] (22 June 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/elisinhinthra.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “game, may ▼ a” → “game, may use 1 Force to ▼ a”; “aboard. While at opponent's system, adds one [Light Side]. Immune to” → “aboard. Immune to”; “to attrition <5.” → “to attrition < 5.”; the errata mark “E1” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the bottom margin “•''Virago''” → “''Virago''” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (354×492 → 745×1039 pixels). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “''Virago''”. Text: “May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Elis, who provides ability of 2. Once per game, may use 1 Force to ▼ a smuggler aboard. Immune to attrition < 5.” This image was first published on 22 June 2021 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/hires/elis_in_hinthra.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ee4c4cd8bccdd1870eb7593e38093132a51fe2c4 commit ee4c4cd]); the card-size GIF uploaded 5 July 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe commit a41bae9], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E2) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-elisinhinthraab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/elisinhinthra.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/elisinhinthra.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “''Virago''”.
